description: This PHP class 'BuzzEmbeddedURL' is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the Buzz Video URL handling component. It provides functionality to generate and validate embedded video URLs for different platforms (YouTube, Vimeo, Dailymotion) based on a given URL.

classes.name: BuzzEmbeddedURL
classes.description: A class to generate and validate embedded URLs for videos from YouTube, Vimeo, and Dailymotion based on an input URL.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class with a URL.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Retrieves the original URL stored in the object.

methods.name: setEmbeddedURL
methods.description: Sets the embedded URL and marks the internal cache as generated.

methods.name: getEmbeddedURL
methods.description: Attempts to generate an embedded URL for supported platforms; returns cached value if already generated.

methods.name: isValidURL
methods.description: Checks if the embedded URL can be successfully generated for the given URL.
